{{recipe}}

An '''oatcake''' is a type of [[Cookbook:Pancake|pancake]] made from [[Cookbook:Oatmeal|oatmeal]],  cooked on a [[Cookbook:Griddle|griddle]]. North Staffordshire oatcakes are a local delicacy in the North Staffordshire (Stoke-on-Trent) area of [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United Kingdom|England]], and so may be known to non-locals as a ''North Staffordshire oatcake'' or ''Potteries oatcake''. These use [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] and [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]], whereas other oatcakes do not. When pre-cooked, they are a form of fast food, and catering outlets in the area usually offer oatcakes with fillings such as [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]], [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]] and [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]. They can be re-heated by [[Cookbook:Frying|frying]] in butter, or by [[Cookbook:Grilling|grilling]]. In addition, [[Cookbook:Pikelet|pikelets]] are often served alongside oatcakes in a similar fashion.

== Ingredients ==
* 220 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] or 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) fine [[Cookbook:Oatmeal|oatmeal]]
* 220 g (1 cup or 8 oz) wholemeal or plain [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 14 g (2 ½ tsp or ½ oz) fresh [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 850 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (3 ½ cups or 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Pint|pints]]) warm [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]] and [[Cookbook:Water|water]], mixed half and half
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

== Procedure ==
# Add the salt to the flour and oatmeal.
# Dissolve the yeast with a little warm liquid and add the sugar. Allow the mixture to become frothy.
# Mix the dry ingredients with the yeast liquid to make a [[Cookbook:Batter|batter]].
# Cover the batter with a clean cloth and leave it in a warm place for an hour.
# Cook the oatcakes on a well-greased [[Cookbook:Griddle|griddle]]. Put enough batter onto the griddle to produce an oatcake about 8–9 [[Cookbook:Inch|inches]] in diameter. The surface will be covered in holes as it cooks. 
# Flip the oatcake after 2–3 minutes when the upper side appears dry and the underneath is golden brown, and cook for another 2–3 minutes.
